description: This file contains unit tests for the KpiService class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It tests methods such as getKpiDao() and saveKpi(), including handling of edge cases like default KPI status and exceptions.

classes.name: KpiServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for KpiService, testing KPI management functionalities including creating, saving, and exception handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetKpiDao
methods.description: Verifies that getKpiDao() returns an instance of KpiDao.

methods.name: testSaveKpi
methods.description: Tests saving a KPI object through KpiService.

methods.name: testSaveKpiWithDefaultTrue
methods.description: Checks if setting a KPI as default correctly updates existing defaults.

methods.name: testSaveKpiWithDefaultTrue2
methods.description: Verifies that saving a new default KPI unsets the previous one.

methods.name: testKpiServiceExceptionForSaveKpi
methods.description: Ensures validation throws an exception if minRating exceeds maxRating.

methods.name: testTransactionExceptionForSaveKpi
methods.description: Checks that a TransactionException is thrown during a DAO failure.
